{{Top|notoc=1}}
'''Tachyons''' were particles that built up on a ship in [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], and were released in a distinctive flash when it reverted to [[Realspace/Legends|realspace]].

[[Hypermatter/Legends|Hypermatter]] was composed of tachyonic particles and when these charged particles were exposed to the constraints of the lower dimensions of realspace produced near-limitless energy.<ref name="DS">[[Death Star (novel)|''Death Star'']]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Out of universe, [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tachyon tachyons] are theoretical particles that move faster than the speed of light, and travel backwards through time.
